basic_info.description: Apartment 1533 is a penthouse level 1 Bedroom 1 Bathroom unit positioned on the north side of the property. Gramercy Towers, located in iconic Nob Hill and next to Grace Cathedral and Huntington Park is a premier San Francisco condominium building with 24-hour doormen and amenities that make for secure and effortless living.  Amenities include 24-hour doormen, on site management and a health club with an indoor pool, equipped exercise area, spa and sauna. The HOA Fee includes heat, electricity, cable TV, internet, earthquake insurance and parking. Onsite laundry located on each residential level. Easy accessibility to transportation, shopping, the financial district and Union Square.
